name: Lauren Troldahl
bio:
Lauren Troldahl is a masterful fineline tattoo artist, renowned for her meticulous attention and steady hand, which allows her to create astonishingly detailed and delicate works of art that gracefully adorn the skin. Her level of professionalism is reflected not only in her superb tattooing skills but also in maintaining a highly clean and hygienic work environment, ensuring every client's safety and comfort during their session. With a portfolio that speaks volumes of her expertise, Lauren is a standout artist at the @feraltattoo collective, whose dedication to her craft keeps her books filled and clients eagerly awaiting their turn.
